items: On the sea chart, each island's land and lakes follow its place on the compass, blending between neighbours: ice in the far north, lava in the volcanic east, oases in the southern desert, dark sinkholes in the western jungle, and glacial tarns, steaming hot springs, rust-red pools and lily ponds between; an island on a border has lakes of both kinds
The sea chart shows the islands at their true sizes, packed over the whole sea, each coast following its neighbour's across a narrow strait
